name: Arctic Night
description: A polar night under the aurora: snowfall, icebergs and a frozen sea. A polar bear and her cub spawn at random, walk across the snow together or alone, and now and then stop to sniff.

steps.script: const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: globalThis.__bear['mom_r_w0'] }); e.name = 'Bear back'; e.src = globalThis.__bear['mom_r_w0']; e.handle = 'm0'; e.x = 130; e.y = 250; e.alpha = 235; e.show = 'normal'; return 1

const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: globalThis.__bear['cub_r_w0'] }); e.name = 'Cub back'; e.src = globalThis.__bear['cub_r_w0']; e.handle = 'c0'; e.x = -400; e.y = 0; e.alpha = 235; e.show = 'normal'; return 1
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Main'; return 1
const n = project.elements.length; for (const i of [n-3,n-2,n-1]) project.elements[i].name += ' Aod'; return 1

const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: globalThis.__bear['mom_l_w0'] }); e.name = 'Bear front'; e.src = globalThis.__bear['mom_l_w0']; e.handle = 'm1'; e.x = 150; e.y = 322; e.alpha = 255; e.show = 'normal'; return 1

const e = await addElement('IMG', { src: globalThis.__bear['cub_l_w0'] }); e.name = 'Cub front'; e.src = globalThis.__bear['cub_l_w0']; e.handle = 'c1'; e.x = 40; e.y = 360; e.alpha = 255; e.show = 'normal'; return 1
for (const k of Object.keys(project.groups)) if (project.groups[k] === 'Clock 2') project.groups[k] = 'Clock AOD'; return JSON.stringify(project.groups)

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gDate = 'Date'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Weekday","Day"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gDate'; n++; } } return 'Date: ' + n + ' layers'

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gBack = 'Bears behind the bank'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Bear back","Cub back"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gBack'; n++; } } return 'Bears behind the bank: ' + n + ' layers'

project.groups = project.groups || {}; project.groups.gFront = 'Bears in front'; let n = 0; for (const nm of ["Bear front","Cub front"]) { const e = project.elements.find((x) => x.name === nm); if (e) { e.group = 'gFront'; n++; } } return 'Bears in front: ' + n + ' layers'

const used = new Set(project.elements.map((e) => e.group).filter(Boolean)); for (const k of Object.keys(project.groups)) if (!used.has(k)) delete project.groups[k]; return JSON.stringify(project.groups)
